panels.title: Como leer este dashboard
panels.description: Guia visible para interpretar los cuadros tecnicos de performance.

options.content:
### Que muestra
Este tablero separa performance tecnica por CPU, RAM, storage, IOPS, red, latencia, throughput, errores y saturacion.

### Como interpretarlo
Picos altos y P95 alto indican consumo sostenido; errores y latencia altos indican degradacion de servicio; saturacion alta indica riesgo operativo. Si no hay datos, falta carga o rango para esa metrica.

### Accion sugerida
Empezar por Top Consumers And Outliers, confirmar la metrica afectada y revisar Threshold Breaches para priorizar remediacion.

panels.title: Average Peak P95
panels.description: Operational KPI table with average, peak, and P95 utilization.

targets.rawSql: select ResourceId, MetricName, AverageUtilization, PeakUtilization, P95Utilization from CapacityKpi order by P95Utilization desc, CalculatedAt desc limit 50

panels.title: Top Consumers And Outliers
panels.description: Highest consumers with ServiceId and ResourceId context for prioritizing operations work.

targets.rawSql: select m.ServiceId, k.ResourceId, k.MetricName, k.PeakUtilization, k.P95Utilization, k.HeadroomAvailable from CapacityKpi k left join ServiceResourceMap m on m.ResourceId = k.ResourceId order by k.P95Utilization desc, k.PeakUtilization desc limit 20

panels.title: Threshold Breaches
panels.description: Warning and Critical conditions with resource/service severity context.

targets.rawSql: select ScopeId, OverallRisk, Reason, CalculatedAt from RiskAssessment where OverallRisk in ('Warning','Critical') order by case OverallRisk when 'Critical' then 2 when 'Warning' then 1 else 0 end desc, CalculatedAt desc limit 50
